issues.description:
[bug-hunt] The pseudo-locale xx-AE never actually renders — the documented "manual QA via ?lng=xx-AE" path silently shows English, defeating the pseudo-locale overflow / missing-key guard.

Root cause: src/i18n/config.ts initI18n() sets `supportedLngs: ["en", "hi", "hinglish"]` (line 76) which OMITS "xx-AE", even though SUPPORTED_LOCALES (line 35) and the resources map (line 56) both include it, and the code comment (lines 91-92) explicitly states xx-AE is "for tests / manual QA via ?lng=xx-AE". With `load: "currentOnly"` and xx-AE absent from supportedLngs, i18next filters the locale out and falls back to en.

EXPECTED: requesting xx-AE (via ?lng=xx-AE, or nyus_locale=xx-AE in localStorage) renders the inflated/accented pseudo strings so text-overflow bugs and missing translation keys surface loudly.
ACTUAL: it renders plain English, so the pseudo-locale QA/overflow-detection path is a silent no-op.

REPRO (node-verified against installed i18next): init with supportedLngs:["en","hi","hinglish"] + load:"currentOnly" + an xx-AE resource, then changeLanguage("xx-AE") -> i18n.language="xx-AE" but resolvedLanguage="en" and t(key) returns the ENGLISH value. Adding "xx-AE" to supportedLngs makes resolvedLanguage="xx-AE" and t(key) return the pseudo value. In-app: append ?lng=xx-AE to any route (querystring detection is enabled) — UI stays English instead of showing pseudo glyphs.

FIX: add "xx-AE" to the supportedLngs array in src/i18n/config.ts (safe — no real browser reports xx-AE as its navigator language, so it will never auto-detect; it only becomes reachable via the explicit ?lng / localStorage paths the comment already documents). Impact: LOW-MED — internal QA tooling, not an end-user crash, but it defeats the overflow/missing-key guard the team relies on.

fix.description: Root cause: initI18n's supportedLngs omitted 'xx-AE' while load:'currentOnly' filtered it out, so ?lng=xx-AE silently fell back to English. Fix: added 'xx-AE' to supportedLngs in src/i18n/config.ts (still never browser-auto-detected). Proof: intro screen now shows the inflated pseudo glyphs.

judge.note: Captured /dev/intro?lng=xx-AE now rendering accented pseudo strings ([NOURISH xx], [Get Started xxxx]) instead of plain English — the overflow/missing-key QA path is live again.

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Body Measurements: typing a value into the measurement number field does nothing — the field silently reverts to the previously-logged value (or 0.00 if none) on the very next render, so a typed value can never be committed. Only the +/- stepper buttons work.

Repro: 1) Open /measurements. 2) Tap the large number field under "Record New Measurement". 3) Type any number (e.g. 45). Expected: field shows 45. Actual: field immediately snaps back to the seeded value (last-logged value for that body part, or 0.00 for a first-ever measurement).

Verified via Playwright on localhost:8080 with a mocked /measurements/ overview (seeded history=33 for Right Arm): typing "45" left the input at "33"; the + button by contrast updates correctly (33 -> steps).

Root cause: the re-seed effect in src/pages/Measurements.tsx (lines 310-321) re-runs on every render (its dep allTypeHistories is a fresh array each render from useQueries) and calls seedFromLatest() whenever userEdited.current is false, overwriting the input. The +/- buttons set userEdited.current=true (lines 580 & 589) so they are exempt, but the text <input> onChange (lines 560-567) never sets userEdited.current, so every keystroke is wiped. Same class as the prior QA i-20260704-22f4 fix (which guarded the steppers) — the text-input path was missed.

Fix: set userEdited.current=true inside the input onChange when a valid value is entered (mirror the stepper buttons). Impact: a first-ever measurement (0 seed) can otherwise only be reached by tapping + up to ~190 times to hit 95cm.

Problem: athletes eat the same breakfast/post-workout shake most days but must reopen the manual-entry modal, hunt the food again via search or the buried "Recent meals" chip row (CustomMealModal.tsx:514-533), and resubmit every time — friction that discourages consistent logging (the exact behavior daily-completion/streak scoring depends on). issues.reviewReason: Two sub-asks. (1) SCROLLING — already implemented in the current build: the 'Choose a photo' sheet (MealSlotCard) now requests 12 photos and renders them in a flex-1 overflow-y-auto region. Verified live in the plan-builder just now: 12 photos load and the region scrolls (scrollHeight 866 > clientHeight 615). The 6-photo/no-scroll screenshot is a pre-fix build. (2) STORAGE MODEL — 'store on frontend, ids on backend' is a data-architecture decision I don't want to guess at. Today the picker stores the full image URL string in the builder draft (localStorage = frontend) and sends that URL to the backend on finalize. Moving to 'id-only on backend' means: define a stable id for each curated photo (catalog index / hash), persist only that id server-side, and resolve id->image client-side. That touches the meal schema + finalize contract + the same meal-photo persistence path 67ca needs. Owner call: confirm the id scheme + whether backend should keep the URL as a fallback, and I'll implement across the plan-builder + RecipeDetail together.
